5422 *ṭakka² 'bald'. 2. *ṭhakka-.
    1. B. ṭāk 'bald patch', ṭākuyā, ṭek° 'bald', Or. ṭākarā; M. ṭakkal n. 'bald spot', ṭakalyā 'bald', ṭakurẽ n., °korī f., ṭakulẽ n., °lī f. 'slang term for head, esp. fore part';B. ṭākrā 'palate' semant. cf. tā́lu-.
    2. Or. ṭhākerā 'bald'.
